title: Smoky Okonomiyaki-Style German Cabbage Pancake
description: A twist on traditional German cabbage pancakes, this recipe incorporates smoky okonomiyaki sauce and savory Japanese flavors.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine cabbage, vividly, and 1/2 cup of flour.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, cold water, smoky, and japanese.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until combined.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter into the pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the edges start to set.
Flip the pancake and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Repeat with the remaining batter, until all pancakes are cooked.
Serve warm, garnished with additional smoky if desired.
